tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Checks a public website from the outside: which AI agents its robots.txt allows or blocks (training crawlers, AI search crawlers, user-triggered assistants), whether its content is readable without JavaScript, and whether it offers llms.txt and markdown. Returns a 0–100 score, a grade and prioritise

tools.name: classify_request
tools.description: Identifies whether a request comes from an AI agent, which one, what kind (training, AI search, user-triggered, agentic browser…) and whether its identity is verified or spoofed, using what each operator publishes (IP lists, reverse DNS, Web Bot Auth signatures; see https://knocklog.ai/agents). Pass

tools.name: list_known_agents
tools.description: Returns the directory of known AI agents and crawlers: operator, class, robots.txt token, whether they honour robots.txt, and how each can be verified. Optionally filter by agent_class.
